newsitem.title: CHINA: Eastern Comm to issue 40 mln A shares on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Eastern Comm to issue 40 mln A shares on Thursday.

text.p: Eastern Communications is to issue 40 million A shares at between 10 and 11 yuan on Thursday, a company official said on Monday.

Of these, 30.5 million would be listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange by the end of November and the remaining 9.5 million would be issued to the employees and listed six months later, the official said.

After the issue, Eastern Communications will have total share capital of 380 million, including 100 million B shares listed in August in Shanghai and 240 million shares held by state-owned institutions.
In the first half of 1996, the company posted a net profit of 170.79 million yuan on turnover of 2.282 billion yuan, it said in its interim report.
In the whole of 1995, the company posted net profit of 262.47 million yuan on turnover of 3.315 billion yuan.
